## ILmdbEnvOptions.noSync property

Skip explicit flush-to-disk on commit.

**Signature:**

```typescript
noSync?: boolean;
```

## Remarks

Significantly faster writes, but a crash may cause data loss. Use only for caches/temp data where durability is not required.
